visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a black North Face fleece jacket and loose-fitting blue jeans, stands in a large gravel camping area. She smiles warmly and gestures enthusiastically with her arms wide open. Behind her, rows of Dawn Redwood trees with yellowish-green autumn foliage line the field under a cloudy, grey sky. (2) The scene shifts to a first-person perspective or a tracking shot moving down a narrow, clean paved road. To the right, tall, dense Dawn Redwood trees with thin, needle-like leaves create a wall of yellow and green. The ground is clear of debris, and the lighting is soft and natural. (3) The woman stands in front of a modern service building with an industrial aesthetic, featuring a grey concrete sink area and several metal faucets. The floor in front of the building has decorative railway tracks. She points toward the entrance of the facility while looking directly at the camera. (4) Inside a shower stall, the camera shows a clean interior with light grey tiled walls. There are two separate shower heads with individual mixers, a wooden bench for belongings, and a frosted glass sliding door that separates the wet area. The woman stands near the door, demonstrating the space. (5) The woman walks through an indoor hallway with a translucent ceiling providing bright, diffuse light. Several light-colored wooden doors line the corridor, leading to individual bathroom units. She points upward and gestures toward the different rooms while talking. (6) A close-up view of a toilet stall reveals light brown, wood-textured wall panels and a clean white porcelain toilet. A child-sized toilet seat is attached to the regular one, and a small shelf holds hand soap. The space is well-lit and appears sanitary. (7) A split-screen view shows a narrow, winding asphalt road flanked by bamboo and thick green trees. In the bottom half, the woman is seen walking in the camping area. She then returns to a full-screen view in the main camp to provide a final summary, smiling and looking into the lens.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 滿滿落羽松營地. [Subtitle]: 這個營地給你滿滿的落羽松. (2) [Subtitle]: 這次我們來到新竹尖石鄉 自由大地. (3) [Subtitle]: 落羽松給你看好看滿. (4) [Subtitle]: 這邊的廁所是集中式的 有分男女廁和集中式的衛浴設備. (5) [Subtitle]: 衛浴區的話就是有兩個吹風機 然後親子間. (6) [Subtitle]: 親子間竟然有兩個水龍頭 跟小朋友洗澡的時候不用你一個我一個. (7) [Subtitle]: 你沖一下我沖一下了. (8) [Subtitle]: 甚至還有乾濕分離的空間 讓你穿衣服的時候 不會再濕濕冷冷的. (9) [Subtitle]: 那目前的話 衛浴間共有七間 但是整個營區呢 就只有這邊有衛浴. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以就是如果住比較上面的 走比較遠一點. (11) [Subtitle]: 這邊是男廁的空間. (12) [Subtitle]: 這邊是女廁的空間. (13) [Subtitle]: 六間全部都是馬桶的 然後還有付小朋友的馬桶蓋. (14) [Subtitle]: 這邊呢 最後的路段比較小條 比較陡峭 所以如果夜衝的朋友的話 一定要小心開喔. (15) [Subtitle]: 但是這邊目前一帳是收1850. (16) [Subtitle]: 你覺得值得嗎 我是覺得很值得啦.

It highlights the seasonal beauty of the Dawn Redwood trees and details the modern, family-friendly toilet and shower facilities to encourage viewers to visit.
